description: This source file defines an asynchronous function to fetch source information from Wikipedia's REST API, returning a list of SourceItem objects with metadata extracted from the page summary.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: Data model representing a source item with details such as claim ID, title, URL, snippet, reliability, stance, provider, and fetch timestamp.

methods.name: List[SourceItem] fetch_wikipedia_sources(claim_id: str, query: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a summary from Wikipedia's REST API based on a query, returning a list with a single SourceItem or empty if not successful.

ctags.name: fetch_wikipedia_sources
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_wikipedia_sources(claim_id: str, query: str) -> List[SourceItem]:$/
